title: Dense stream of consciousness — longest, hardest case
raw: okay so uh there's a lot to cover so bear with me first thing is the server costs are like way too high right now we're spending like twelve thousand a month no actually closer to fourteen thousand on aws and i think we can cut that by like thirty percent if we move the staging environment to spot instances and also we should probably look at the database because we're running three read replicas and honestly we probably only need two and that alone would save like two thousand a month maybe more second thing is the team i think we need to have a hard conversation with marcus because his code quality has been slipping and he's missed two deadlines now the last one was the payment integration which was supposed to ship june first and it's now june seventeenth and it's still not done and i talked to priya about it and she thinks he might be burned out which tracks because he's been working weekends for the last two months and the third thing is the investor update we have a board meeting on july eighth no wait the tenth and we need to have the deck ready at least three days before so that's july seventh and right now we don't have the q two numbers finalized because finance is still reconciling some stuff and tom said it'll be done by end of this week so we should be fine as long as we don't push again
reference:
A few things to cover:

**Server costs**: We're spending about $14K/month on AWS. We can probably cut that by 30% by moving staging to spot instances and dropping from three read replicas to two — that alone saves around $2K/month.

**Team**: We need to have a hard conversation with Marcus. His code quality has been slipping and he's missed two deadlines. The payment integration was due June 1 and it's still not done as of June 17. Priya thinks he might be burned out, which tracks — he's been working weekends for two months.

**Investor update**: Board meeting is July 10. We need the deck ready by July 7. Q2 numbers aren't finalized yet — finance is still reconciling. Tom said it'll be done by end of this week, so we should be fine.
